faqs.q: How does the one-time 10% license fee work?
faqs.a: When you deposit, a one-time 10% fee is automatically deducted from the contributed amount to unlock the use of Polar One. It is charged only once, at the time of deposit, and covers the licensing of the algorithmic trading software — there are no monthly fees or recurring charges for using the platform.

faqs.q: Is the license fee charged on every new deposit?
faqs.a: Yes. The 10% fee is applied to each new amount deposited, as it corresponds to the licensing of the capital that will be operated by Polar One. Balances reinvested from already distributed profits do not pay license again.

faqs.q: How is the performance fee calculated?
faqs.a: The performance fee applies exclusively to profits generated by Polar One — never on the deposited capital. The percentage varies by plan (from 40% on Starter to 20% on Enterprise). If there is no profit in the week, no performance fee is charged.

faqs.q: Is there a high-water mark on the performance fee?
faqs.a: Yes. Performance is only charged on new net profits above the highest value ever recorded in your account. If there are weeks with negative results, you only start paying performance again after your account exceeds the previous mark — ensuring you never pay twice for the same profit.
Result distribution happens every Friday at 23:00 UTC, directly in your back-office. After credit, you can reinvest, keep on the account or request withdrawal at any time.

Yes. The process is 100% automated: at the end of the weekly cycle, the system calculates the net result, deducts the performance fee corresponding to your plan and credits the available profit to your internal wallet in the back-office.

faqs.q: Can I withdraw my capital at any time?
faqs.a: Yes. You can request partial or total withdrawal of your contribution whenever you want, with no lock-up period. Withdrawals are processed automatically 24/7, in USDT.

faqs.q: How does the decreasing exit fee work?
faqs.a: To cover operational costs, a one-time fee is applied on the withdrawn amount: 10% in the first 12 months after the deposit, 5% between 12 and 24 months, and free after 24 months. The count is per deposit, so older contributions may already be exempt.

faqs.q: Is there a minimum or maximum withdrawal amount?
faqs.a: There is no maximum amount — you can withdraw your entire available balance at any time. The minimum withdrawal amount is 10 USDT to cover blockchain network costs.

faqs.q: Can I change plans after starting?
faqs.a: Yes. As your balance grows, you can migrate to higher plans and start paying a lower performance fee. The change is automatic when your capital reaches the next level's range, but it can also be requested manually in the back-office.

items.q: How long has Polar Tensor existed?
items.a: Polar Tensor was founded in 2018 as a research center for AI trading algorithms. The first profitable version of our system went into production in 2020, and we have since gone through multiple iterations to the current Polar One version.

items.q: Who are the founders and the team behind the project?
items.a: Polar Tensor is composed of a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, machine learning engineers, quantitative mathematicians and professionals with experience in traditional and crypto financial markets. The team is distributed across our operations in the USA, Europe, Hong Kong and Panama.

items.q: Is Polar Tensor a broker or an investment fund?
items.a: Neither. We are a technology company that licenses the use of a proprietary automated trading system. You keep control of your deposits, and the system only executes operations through authorized APIs on exchanges like Binance.

items.q: Why does Polar Tensor have entities in several countries?
items.a: Each jurisdiction plays a specific role: the USA (Wyoming) hosts the regulated financial structure (FinCEN MSB), Poland meets European requirements, Hong Kong concentrates research and development, and Panama centralizes technical operation. This structure ensures global compliance and regulatory resilience.

items.q: Is the company audited by independent third parties?
items.a: Yes. Our legal and financial structure is periodically reviewed by one of the four major global audit firms (Big Four), ensuring transparency on corporate constitution, regulatory compliance and governance.

items.q: What sets Polar One apart from common trading bots?
items.a: Traditional bots execute fixed rules (grid, DCA, moving averages). Polar One uses two distinct neural networks — one for trend and one for direction — trained with billions of market data points. The system learns non-linear patterns that rule-based strategies simply cannot identify.

items.q: On which exchange does the system operate?
items.a: We currently operate exclusively on Binance, due to liquidity depth, low institutional fees and API infrastructure robustness. This allows high-frequency execution with minimal latency.

items.q: Which assets does Polar One trade?
items.a: The system mainly operates on the most liquid pairs in the crypto market, focusing on BTC and ETH against USDT, with potential to expand to other pairs depending on market conditions and available liquidity.

items.q: Does the system use leverage?
items.a: Polar One operates with conservative leverage, typically between 1x and 3x, depending on the active strategy and market conditions. The focus is capital preservation: the system avoids aggressive exposure and prioritizes weekly consistency over high one-off returns, significantly reducing the risk of liquidation compared to high-leverage strategies.

items.q: Is the algorithm retrained over time?
items.a: Yes. The neural networks undergo continuous retraining as new market data is incorporated. This allows the system to adapt to regime changes — bull market, bear market, high volatility or consolidation.

items.q: What happens if Binance or the internet goes down?
items.a: Our infrastructure runs on redundant servers in data centers close to Binance's servers, with automatic failover. In the event of instability of the exchange itself, the system enters safe mode, closing open positions according to predefined protocols.

items.q: Can I see the system's operation history?
items.a: Yes. After sign-up, you have access to the panel with detailed history of operations, weekly performance, drawdown, win rate and other relevant metrics. All possible transparency within what does not compromise the algorithm's intellectual property.

items.q: What is the minimum amount to start?
items.a: The minimum entry amount at Polar Tensor is 1,000 USDT, equivalent to the initial plan. Intermediate plans start at 10,000 USDT and advanced plans, with reduced performance fees and dedicated relationship manager, start at 50,000 USDT. All amounts are deposited in cryptocurrencies (BTC, ETH, SOL or USDT) directly to your linked account.

items.q: How long does it take for the deposit to be confirmed?
items.a: Deposits in Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and USDT are confirmed after the standard number of blockchain network confirmations — usually between 10 and 30 minutes, depending on the network used and congestion.

items.q: How do withdrawals work?
items.a: Withdrawals are processed automatically 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, in USDT or USDC. After the request in the panel, the amount is sent to the indicated wallet after security validation.

items.q: Is there a minimum lock-up period?
items.a: There is no mandatory lock-up of capital. However, we recommend a minimum horizon of a few weeks for the effect of weekly profit compounding to manifest significantly.

items.q: Can I deposit via PIX or credit card?
items.a: Not directly. Capital entry is exclusively in cryptocurrencies. You can easily acquire crypto on local exchanges via PIX and transfer to the address provided in your panel.

items.q: Can I make additional deposits after starting?
items.a: Yes. Additional deposits are allowed at any time and start yielding alongside existing capital. If the deposit exceeds the current plan limit, you can migrate to a higher plan.

items.q: When and how are profits distributed?
items.a: Profits are distributed weekly, every Friday at 23:00 UTC, automatically in your panel. You can choose to withdraw or reinvest to enhance compounding.

items.q: Does the performance fee apply to capital or only to profits?
items.a: Only to profits. If there is no profit in a week, no performance fee is charged. The fee varies between 20% and 30% depending on the contracted plan.

items.q: Is the 10% license fee charged every month?
items.a: No. The 10% license fee is one-time, charged once on the initial deposited amount, granting the right to lifetime use of the system within that plan.

items.q: Is there any hidden withdrawal or movement fee?
items.a: We do not charge additional withdrawal fees. You only bear the blockchain network fee (gas fee) when sending to your external wallet.

items.q: Are profits guaranteed?
items.a: No. No serious trading system offers profit guarantees. We present audited historical results, but past performance does not guarantee future results. Trading involves real risks of loss.

items.q: Is there a high water mark?
items.a: Yes. The performance fee uses high water mark: we only charge performance again when your balance exceeds the previous peak, avoiding double charging during recovery periods.

items.q: Are my funds custodied by Polar Tensor?
items.a: Operational funds remain in dedicated accounts on Binance, linked to your registration. Polar Tensor operates via APIs with permission restricted to trading — without withdrawal permission to external addresses.

items.q: What happens if Polar Tensor ceases activities?
items.a: As capital is allocated in segregated environment and we maintain corporate structure across multiple jurisdictions with Big Four audit, there are formal capital return and orderly closure protocols described in the terms of use.

items.q: How do you protect my personal data?
items.a: We follow practices aligned with LGPD (Brazil) and GDPR (Europe). Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, with access restricted by permission levels and periodic internal audit.

items.q: Does the platform require two-factor authentication (2FA)?
items.a: Yes. 2FA is mandatory for all accounts, using apps like Google Authenticator or Authy. Withdrawals require additional email confirmation.

items.q: Do you have insurance against technological failures?
items.a: We maintain operational risk mitigation protocols, including infrastructure redundancy and technical reserve fund. Specific coverage terms are in the contractual documentation made available after sign-up.

items.q: Is this a pyramid or Ponzi scheme?
items.a: No. Pyramids pay older participants with capital from new entrants; our model generates revenue exclusively from algorithmic execution in real markets, with statements verifiable on Binance and external audit. There is no promise of fixed return or dependence on recruitment.

items.q: Who can open an account at Polar Tensor?
items.a: Individuals over 18 with valid documentation, residing in jurisdictions where our services are authorized. We do not serve residents of countries under international sanctions or on restrictive lists.

items.q: Do I need to go through KYC verification?
items.a: Yes. As a regulated entity (Polar MSB Inc., FinCEN), we follow KYC and AML policies. Verification involves official document, proof of address and proof of life (selfie).

items.q: How long does it take to approve my account?
items.a: After complete documentation submission, verification is usually completed within 48 business hours. In cases requiring additional review, the compliance team contacts directly.

items.q: How can I reach support?
items.a: Official support is available through the logged panel, email and WhatsApp. For higher-plan clients, we offer dedicated service with relationship manager.

items.q: Do you offer support in English?
items.a: Yes. Customer support is provided in English (and other languages), in extended business hours, by professionals trained in the technical details of the platform.

items.q: Can I have more than one account?
items.a: No. We maintain the policy of one account per individual document, in accordance with our KYC policies and platform abuse prevention.

items.q: How does the referral program work?
items.a: By referring new clients through your unique link, you receive a commission on the performance fees generated by your referrals. The model is transparent, without multiple recruitment levels that characterize pyramids.

items.q: Do I need to be an active client to refer people?
items.a: Yes. The referral program is exclusive for active clients with current deposit. This ensures that those recommending Polar Tensor really know the platform.

items.q: Is there a referral limit?
items.a: There is no limit on the number of people you can refer. Commissions are credited weekly along with profit distribution.

paragraphs: This Privacy Notice describes how personal data is collected, stored, shared and protected in the scope of services offered by the Polar Tensor group.

KYC and AML verification data, including identity documents and proof of life;
after: Sensitive data is only processed when strictly necessary and permitted by law.

sections.title: Processing purposes
paragraphs: Data is processed for legitimate purposes such as: onboarding and account administration, identity verification, fraud prevention, service provision, accounting record, system security and integrity, regulatory obligations, and customer communication.
We do not perform automated decisions with relevant legal effects without adequate safeguards.

sections.title: Legal bases
paragraphs: Processing is performed on one or more of the following bases, as applicable: contract execution, compliance with legal and regulatory obligations, legitimate interest (including security and fraud prevention) and consent, where required.

sections.title: Sharing and recipients
paragraphs: Data may be shared, when necessary and permitted by law, with: group entities, regulated providers (KYC, suppliers, payment processors), execution and infrastructure partners, auditors, legal advisors and regulatory authorities.
We do not sell personal data to third parties.

sections.title: International transfers
paragraphs: When international transfers occur, we apply adequate safeguards such as adequacy decisions, standard contractual clauses or other legally recognized mechanisms. We limit transfers to what is necessary for operational and compliance purposes.

sections.title: Data retention
paragraphs: Data is retained for the time necessary to comply with contractual, legal and regulatory obligations, or for defense of rights. Periods vary according to the type of data and applicable legislation.

sections.title: Data security
paragraphs: We adopt adequate technical and organizational measures to protect data against unauthorized access, loss, destruction, alteration and misuse. Despite this, no system is 100% secure.

sections.title: Data subject rights
paragraphs: According to applicable legislation, you may have the right to: access your data, request correction or deletion, restrict or object to processing, request portability and lodge a complaint with the competent authority.
Requests may be subject to verification and legal limits.

sections.title: Cookies and tracking technologies
paragraphs: Our sites may use cookies and similar technologies for: security, functionality, analytics, performance monitoring and user experience optimization. Consent mechanisms are provided when required.

sections.title: No waiver of obligations
paragraphs: Nothing in this Notice limits or excludes rights or obligations imposed by applicable data protection laws.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: This Notice may be updated periodically to reflect legal, regulatory or operational changes. The most recent version will always be available on our website.

paragraphs: These Terms of Use govern access to and use of technology platforms, interfaces, dashboards, websites and execution-related software tools, made available within the scope of the Polar Tensor group.
These Terms do not replace any applicable client agreement governing custody, payments or relationships with licensed entities.
By accessing or using the Platform, you acknowledge that you have read, understood and agree to be bound by these Terms.

sections.title: Parties and scope
paragraphs: The Platform is operated and made available by the following entities, acting strictly in their respective roles:
list: Polar Tensor Corp. — operation of execution technology and automated trading infrastructure;
Polar Tensor US LLC — client access for USA and non-EU users;
Polar Tensor Europe SP ZOO — client access for EU users.
after: Access rights and functionality may vary by jurisdiction and regulatory status.

sections.title: Nature of the Platform
paragraphs: The Platform provides technology and execution-only functionality, including: access to automated execution tools, display of account information, initiation of execution processes by explicit user instruction and technical connectivity with third-party execution venues.
The Platform does not provide investment advice, discretionary portfolio management or personalized recommendations.

sections.title: Eligibility and access
paragraphs: You may access and use the Platform only if: you have been duly onboarded by the applicable licensed entity, you meet the legal eligibility requirements in your jurisdiction and your access has not been suspended or terminated.
The group reserves the right to restrict or deny access when required by law, regulation or compliance obligations.

sections.title: User control and activation
paragraphs: The automated execution functionality: is inactive by default; requires manual and explicit activation by the user; can be deactivated by the user at any time, subject to technical processing restrictions.
No execution occurs without user initiation.

sections.title: Execution-only nature
paragraphs: All execution performed by the Platform: is non-discretionary; follows predefined system logic; is not tailored to individual users; is limited to spot crypto-asset transactions.
No fiduciary, advisory or discretionary relationship is created by the use of the Platform.

sections.title: User obligations
paragraphs: You agree to: use the Platform only for lawful purposes; comply with all applicable laws and regulations; maintain the confidentiality of access credentials; monitor activity associated with your account; promptly notify the applicable entity of any unauthorized access or security incident.

sections.title: Prohibited conduct
paragraphs: You shall not: misuse or interfere with the Platform or its operation; attempt unauthorized access to systems or data; reverse engineer or circumvent technical safeguards; use the Platform for unlawful or abusive purposes; engage in conduct that may harm the integrity or security of the Platform.

sections.title: Availability and modifications
paragraphs: The Platform is provided "as is" and "as available". The group may: modify, suspend or discontinue features; perform maintenance or updates; restrict access when required for legal, technical or security reasons.
There is no guarantee of uninterrupted availability.

sections.title: Third-party services
paragraphs: The Platform may integrate or connect with third-party services, including execution venues and infrastructure providers. The group does not control such third parties and is not responsible for their actions, availability or performance.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the maximum extent permitted by law: no liability is accepted for losses arising from market movements, execution delays, system interruptions or third-party failures; no liability is accepted for indirect or consequential damages; liability is limited as set forth in the applicable client agreement.
Nothing in these Terms excludes liabilities that cannot be excluded by applicable law.

sections.title: Intellectual property
paragraphs: All intellectual property associated with the Platform remains the property of the Polar Tensor group or its licensors. Use of the Platform does not transfer any ownership or intellectual property rights.

sections.title: Suspension and termination
paragraphs: Access to the Platform may be suspended or terminated: for breach of these Terms; when required by law or regulation; for security or compliance reasons; upon termination of the underlying client relationship.

sections.title: Applicable law and jurisdiction
paragraphs: These Terms are governed by the laws specified in the applicable client agreement, without prejudice to mandatory consumer protection laws.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: These Terms may be updated periodically. Continued use of the Platform constitutes acceptance of the most current version.

risk.seoDesc: Polar Tensor Risk Disclosure Statement on digital assets, automated trading, market, regulatory, technological and liquidity risks.
risk.heroSubtitle: Digital assets, automated trading and technology services.
risk.warning: Trading in digital assets involves significant risks. You may lose part or all of your capital. This statement does not constitute investment advice, recommendation or performance guarantee.

sections.title: Purpose of this statement
paragraphs: This Risk Disclosure Statement aims to inform clients and potential users of the services about the main risks related to: digital assets and crypto-asset markets, automated and algorithmic trading technology, execution services and the use of third-party infrastructure and services.
This statement is part of the pre-contractual information provided to the client and should be read in conjunction with applicable terms, disclosures and agreements.

sections.title: General risk warning
paragraphs: Digital assets are high-risk products. Participation in digital asset markets and the use of automated trading technology may result in partial or total loss of capital.
You should only use the services if you fully understand the nature of the risks involved and can bear the full loss of allocated amounts.
Past performance, real or simulated, is not indicative of future results.

sections.title: Market risk
paragraphs: Digital asset markets are subject to high volatility. Prices can fluctuate rapidly and unpredictably due to, among others: market sentiment and speculation, liquidity conditions, regulatory events, technological changes, macroeconomic events and market participant actions.
Adverse movements may result in rapid losses without warning.

sections.title: No performance guarantee or capital protection
paragraphs: No entity in the group offers: profit or return guarantees; capital insurance or preservation; minimum performance targets; representations about expected results.
All trading activity is performed at the client's sole account and risk.

sections.title: Automated and algorithmic trading risk
paragraphs: Automated and algorithmic systems operate based on predefined rules and logic. Risks associated with automated trading include, among others: adverse market conditions not anticipated by the system, execution at unfavorable prices, latency under certain market conditions, limitations inherent to historical data or model assumptions.
Automated systems may perform poorly or unpredictably under certain market conditions.

sections.title: No investment advice or discretion
paragraphs: Services are provided on an execution and technology-only basis. We do not provide investment advice, suitability assessment, continuous monitoring of client portfolio or act as investment manager.
Decisions to evaluate, deactivate, deposit, withdraw or allocate funds remain entirely with the client.

sections.title: Technology and operational risk
paragraphs: Services depend on complex technological systems, including software, hardware, networks and third-party infrastructure. Potential risks include: system outages or downtime, latency or execution delays, software errors or bugs, cybersecurity incidents and third-party provider failure.
Although reasonable measures are implemented to maintain system integrity, uninterrupted and error-free operation cannot be guaranteed.

sections.title: Custody and execution layer risk
paragraphs: Client assets may be subject to custody arrangements, including operational risks, domain risks, failures in third-party service providers, blockchain network congestion or failure and risks associated with execution venues and liquidity providers.
Temporary asset transfers for execution purposes are subject to operational risks of the execution layer.

sections.title: Regulatory and legal risk
paragraphs: The regulatory treatment of digital assets may change. Future legislative, regulatory or enforcement actions may: restrict or prohibit certain activities, impose additional compliance obligations, affect the availability of services or impact the value or marketability of digital assets.
Regulatory changes may occur with little or no notice.

sections.title: Liquidity risk
paragraphs: Certain digital assets may have limited liquidity. This may result in: difficulty entering or exiting positions, increased slippage, execution at materially different prices than expected and inability to execute within desired time frames.

sections.title: Counterparty and third-party risk
paragraphs: Services depend on third-party providers, including: exchanges, liquidity providers, payment processors, custody technology providers and infrastructure suppliers.
Failures, insolvency, misconduct or operational interruptions of third parties may adversely affect service availability or execution results.

sections.title: Extraordinary events and force majeure
paragraphs: Extraordinary events outside reasonable control — including, among others, natural disasters, war, regulatory emergencies, market or network failures — may impair or suspend services.
Such events may result in losses or delays for which no guarantee or compensation can be provided.

sections.title: Acknowledgment of client responsibility
paragraphs: By using the services, clients acknowledge and accept that: they have read and understood these risks; they have independently assessed the risks involved; they are solely responsible for their decisions and actions; they are aware of possible losses and expectations.
Clients should seek independent professional advice if they have questions about the risks.

sections.title: No reliance representation
paragraphs: Clients should not rely on any statements, materials or communications as guarantees of profitability, security or results.
Only binding contractual documentation governs the legal relationship.
